content_text: Ah the boot issue. One year, around the Oscars time, there was a panel of the 5 cinematographers to discuss their films and it ended up becoming a discussion of Roger’s boots (Georgia boots [farm boots], I believe) that evolved into a free flowing discussion of the importance of the right footwear when shooting. It was funny. And probably not what the moderators were looking for!
